raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The DE-412 change on 2026-01-17 added `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` to silver_transactions. Every batch contains POSTED transactions that arrive more than 26 hours after txn_ts (for example batch 11 holds txns from 01-13 ingested 01-16). The filter silently drops these real transactions, which causes the RAW_TO_SILVER shortfalls and understated gold totals.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
